programmes.d: Warren realizes the gravity of extracting Murphy and finds an old ally in El Escorpion.
Doc and Addy try to convince Lucy's family to follow them. Murphy tests 10K's allegiance.
Doc tries to find a way to tell Warren about Lucy's kidnapping.
Warren leads an attack against Murphytown to extract its smug leader.
Addy is being pummeled with whatever The Man can throw at her - and Lucy does the same right back.
The gang reunites and faces a battle.
Warren's apocalyptic dream of a Black Rainbow sends the group on a mysterious new mission.
Driven by her dream of a black rainbow and flesh-eating rain, Warren and Murphy escape Zona.
10K and the group must decide whether to keep looking for Sun Mei and Red, or press on to Newmerica.
Following Warren's dream, the team doesn't stop while crossing the Great Pile.
The team is captured by a mysterious entity and enslaved in an elaborate underground facility.
Lucy fights to save Murphy's life; Warren and the others battle a biologically modified zombie.
Warren is unable to stop Murphy and the others from committing an atrocity as misplaced revenge.
Warren and the group encounter a mysterious stranger who they think is a grave robber.
The group explores an abandoned TV station while seeking a way to contact Kaya.
Doc and the group are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a barber shop.
Warren's dream leads the group back to Mercy Labs where she must perform a dangerous task.
Warren and the group must stop Zona from launching operation Black Rainbow.
The team arrives in Washington, D.C. and the secret of Warren's dreams is revealed.
Following the drone crash, Warren is nursed back to health by attractive homesteader Cooper.
In the outpost Altura, 10K searched for Red, Murphy encounters Sun Mei and Doc runs into Citizen Z.
Panic and anti-talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote - rumors blame a talker.
Warren and George search for Lt. Dante, who may be part of an underground network helping Talkers.
A new spate of terrorist bombings hit Pacifica. George follows his vision for human-talker unity.
Warren and the others are reunited with Addy in Limbo, an underground casino.
Doc treats George's injury and explains the Founding Fathers, the Bill of Rights and more.
The group arrives at the farming outpost that produces flour for Z-bizkuits, but danger awaits.
The group is reunited with old friends who are defending a dam that controls Newmerica's water.
